en: A black and white image showing a busy street scene from the early 20th century. The street is crowded with people, mostly men in suits and hats, as well as numerous horses lined up, suggesting a livestock or horse market. The buildings have classic late 19th or early 20th-century European architecture, with a large church or official building visible in the background. There are street signs and some small tents or stalls visible in the scene.
